situation: A card issuer whose analysts review fraud alerts one by one.
complication: Alerts now exceed what analysts can review, so some go unreviewed each month.
key_question: How should alerts be prioritised so the riskiest are reviewed first?

titles.situation: Alert volume has outgrown the review team.
titles.options: Two ways to put the riskiest alerts first.
titles.recommendation: Rank alerts by risk so the fraud manager reviews the riskiest first.
titles.roadmap: Rank the queue now, then measure what the ranking catches.
titles.kpis: Two measures show whether the ranking works.
titles.risks: A poor ranking could push real fraud to the back of the queue.
